name: Cedar Cove Camping
note: Campground at Pointe-Verte (115 Rue Principale) on the Baie des Chaleurs shore road; 2- or 3-way 30-amp RV sites C$50 + HST a night ($300 a week), tent sites $40; season May 15-Sept 30; booking requests online. Also rents an RV on site. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: cedarcovecamping.ca live with a rates page (RV site 2/3-way 30A $50 + HST, read 2026-10-07; the $110-130 figures are its rental RV) and online booking requests; Google 4.0 over 44 reviews with phone; Good Sam lists it; C$50 ~ US$36
